items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about Freddie Goodman, did you know him? [INTERVIEWEE] Freddie, no I didn't know him.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well Ham Russon was no piano, he was a tenor player too. Spelled his name a different way and he used to work with Hackett I just wanted to know. Oh yeah. What about Freddie Goodman, did you know him? Freddie, no I didn't know him.
The trumpet player? The trumpet player. Was Freddie played the trumpet or who was he playing the bass?
